create_decision_boundary_plot: create a decision boundary plot from a fitted scikit-learn classifier using DecisionBoundaryDisplay.from_estimator
plot_decision_boundary_contour: plot a decision boundary visualization using contourf method on a matplotlib axes with DecisionBoundaryDisplay.plot
validate_response_method: validate which response method a fitted estimator supports for decision boundary plotting
build_multiclass_decision_boundary: build a multiclass decision boundary plot with per-class coloring using DecisionBoundaryDisplay.from_estimator and multiclass_colors
test_predict_proba_boundary: test a decision boundary plot using predict_proba response method with class_of_interest to visualize a single class
